Analytics and Growth

Know what moves the business.

Replace disconnected reports with a shared view of performance. Build measurement that supports decisions across marketing and product.

The problem behind the brief.

Disconnected reports make decisions slow. Marketing and sales need a common definition of a useful lead and a clear view of what happens next.

Our approach

Agree the decisions and conversion definitions first. Review tracking and CRM data, implement the measurement plan and create reporting the team can act on.

Good questions.

Where do we start?

With a discovery conversation, access review and a prioritized scope. Recommendations follow the evidence, not a preset package.

How is success measured?

We agree a baseline and reporting cadence around tracking coverage · funnel conversion · experiment impact. Targets are set after discovery; outcomes are never guaranteed.

Can you work with our team?

Yes. The engagement can complement your internal marketing, product and engineering teams, with responsibilities agreed before delivery.
